description: EzKit is a tech team from Ghardaia, Algeria, that combines medicine, AI, robotics, and computer science. We turn curiosity and technology into practical solutions, tackling space challenges, learning, innovating, and representing Algeria internationally.
summary:
Using just a frontend composed of technologies like TypeScript, Vite and a simple proxy to route SIAv2 due to CORS, Were able to just have low maintance web app that relies on NASA servers and a simple provider to host the app.
this tool satisfies the main subject and some optional ones, and if were allowed to further develop it so it become more than just a research tool and actually becomes educational
details:
the project is a web app and it fully relies on servers of NASA resourecs to work with no real "backend"
low maintance due to no need for backend
the tools were neovim with lsp and claude code used to develop using Typescript + Vite with npm as the builder
we intend to develop also for amateurs too using interactive tutorials to showcase how to use it
we factored in the fact that since NASA gives all the data we could eleminate any use for a backend
